# St. Marys Heating & Cooling

> St. Marys Heating & Cooling provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around St. Marys, Perth County, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (519) 284-0161  |  Email: contact@stmarysheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://stmarysheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: St. Marys, Stratford, Perth South, Wildwood, Embro
